no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was conducted for this application. No issues were identified during the review cycle that required expert input from an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the ANNOVERA (NDA209627) application. Section 12 of the FDA multidisciplinary review states that no Advisory Committee meeting was conducted because no issues were identified during the review cycle that required expert input. There are therefore no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
